These eight XML files were generated from CMI Docx revision
`3449b942034129ad74a28aeb253361035806e385` (0.6.16), using Python 3.12.14,
python-docx 1.2.0, and lxml. `generate_reference.py` verifies the source checkout
revision before regenerating them.

The comparison in `tests/reference.rs` checks paragraph content, section counts,
and section-break positions. `tests/text_runs.rs` also compares text-run boundaries
with `runs.xml`, including explicit empty runs. Comparisons ignore XML prefixes, namespace
declarations, default template formatting, and ZIP metadata. Trailing excluded
sections and stateful predicates have explicitly documented Rust behavior; they
are tested in `tests/resolution.rs` rather than asserted equivalent to Python.

`features.docx` is generated by `generate_features.py` from the same pinned CMI
source. It covers formatting, styles, comments, images, nested/merged tables,
headers/footers, sections and metadata. `images/` contains tiny synthetic red
24×12 images generated using Pillow (PNG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF at 144 DPI; GIF at its
default 72 DPI). No user data is included.

`sample_zero_dpi.png` checks the upstream 72-DPI fallback for zero-valued PNG density metadata.
